title: CHAPTER 1: BASICS OF ECONOMICS
content:
👋 ሰላም ሰላም ውድ የEthioFresh ቤተሰቦች! እንደምን አላችሁ? በዚህ የመጀመሪያ ክላሳችን የFreshman Economics Course የመጀመሪያውን ክፍል (Chapter 1 - Part 1) ይዘንላችሁ መጥተናል። በዚህ ክፍል Economics ምንድን ነው? የEconomics ዋና የትኩረት አቅጣጫዎች (Micro vs Macro)፣ Positive vs Normative Analysis እና Inductive vs Deductive Reasoning የሚሉትን መሰረታዊ ነጥቦች በስፋትና በጥልቀት እንመለከታለን። ፈተና ላይ በብዛት የሚወጡ ፅንሰ-ሀሳቦች ስላሉ በደንብ ተከታተሉኝ። 👇👇👇


Chapter One: Basics of Economics

1.1 Definition of Economics

Economics is one of the most exciting disciplines in social sciences. The word economy comes from the Greek phrase "one who manages a household".
👉 የቃሉ አመጣጥ: የኢኮኖሚክስ ቃል የመጣው "የቤተሰብ/የቤት አስተዳዳሪ" ከሚል የግሪክ ሀረግ የተወሰደ ነው።

The science of economics in its current form is about two hundred years old. Adam Smith – generally known as the father of economics – brought out his famous book, "An Inquiry into the Nature and Causes of Wealth of Nations", in the year 1776. Though many other writers expressed important economic ideas before Adam Smith, economics as a distinct subject started with his book.
👉 የኢኮኖሚክስ አባት (Father of Economics): አዳም ስሚዝ (Adam Smith) በ1776 እ.ኤ.አ "Wealth of Nations" የተባለውን መጽሐፉን በማሳተም ኢኮኖሚክስ ራሱን የቻለ የትምህርት ዘርፍ እንዲሆን አድርጓል።

There is no universally accepted definition of economics (its definition is controversial). This is because different economists defined economics from different perspectives:
a. Wealth definition
b. Welfare definition
c. Scarcity definition, and
d. Growth definition
👉 የተለያዩ ብያኔዎች: ለኢኮኖሚክስ አንድ ወጥ የሆነ ትርጉም የለውም። ምክንያቱም ኢኮኖሚስቶች ከሀብት፣ ከደህንነት፣ ከእጥረት እና ከዕድገት አንፃር በተለያዩ እይታዎች ስለሚበይኑት ነው።

Hence, its definition varies as the nature and scope of the subject grow over time. But, the formal and commonly accepted definition is as follows:

Economics is a social science which studies about efficient allocation of scarce resources so as to attain the maximum fulfillment of unlimited human needs. As economics is a science of choice, it studies how people choose to use scarce or limited productive resources (land, labour, equipment, technical knowledge and the like) to produce various commodities.
👉 ይፋዊ ትርጉም (Formal Definition): ኢኮኖሚክስ የማህበራዊ ሳይንስ (Social Science) ዘርፍ ሲሆን፣ የሚያጠናውም ውስን የሆኑ ሀብቶችን (Scarce resources) በጥበብ እና በብቃት (Efficient allocation) በመጠቀም ያልተገደቡ የሰው ልጅ ፍላጎቶችን (Unlimited human needs) እስከ ከፍተኛው ደረጃ እንዴት ማሟላት እንደምንችል ነው።

The following statements are derived from the above definition:
• Economics studies about scarce resources; (ስለ ውስን ሀብቶች ያጠናል)
• It studies about allocation of resources; (ስለ ሀብት ክፍፍል ያጠናል)
• Allocation should be efficient; (ክፍፍሉ ውጤታማ/በብቃት መሆን አለበት)
• Human needs are unlimited; (የሰው ልጅ ፍላጎት ያልተገደበ ነው)
• The aim (objective) of economics is to study how to satisfy the unlimited human needs up to the maximum possible degree by allocating the resources efficiently.
👉 ዋና አላማ: ሀብትን በብቃት በመደብ ያልተገደበውን የሰው ልጅ ፍላጎት እስከ ከፍተኛው ደረጃ ማሟላት ነው።

💡 Exam Hint: ፈተና ላይ "Who is known as the father of economics?" ከተባላችሁ መልሱ Adam Smith ነው! እንዲሁም የኢኮኖሚክስ ዋና አላማ Efficient allocation of scarce resources to meet unlimited wants መሆኑን በደንብ ያዙት።


1.2 The Rationales of Economics

There are two fundamental facts that provide the foundation for the field of economics:
1) Human (society's) material wants are unlimited.
2) Economic resources are limited (scarce).
👉 ሁለቱ ዋና መነሻዎች (Fundamental Facts): 1) የሰው ልጅ ፍላጎት ያልተገደበ (Unlimited) መሆኑ እና 2) ፍላጎቱን ለማሟላት የሚያስፈልጉት ሀብቶች ውስን/አነስተኛ (Limited/Scarce) መሆናቸው ናቸው።

The basic economic problem is about scarcity and choice since there are only limited amount of resources available to produce the unlimited amount of goods and services we desire. Thus, economics is the study of how human beings make choices to use scarce resources as they seek to satisfy their unlimited wants. Therefore, choice is at the heart of all decision-making.
👉 መሰረታዊ የኢኮኖሚ ችግር (Basic Economic Problem): የኢኮኖሚክስ ዋና ችግር Scarcity (እጥረት) እና Choice (ምርጫ) ነው። ሀብታችን ውስን በመሆኑ ምክንያት ሁልጊዜ ለመምረጥ (Choice ማድረግ) እንገደዳለን።

As an individual, family, and nation, we confront difficult choices about how to use limited resources to meet our needs and wants. Economists study how these choices are made in various settings; evaluate the outcomes in terms of criteria such as efficiency, equity, and stability; and search for alternative forms of economic organization that might produce higher living standards or a more desirable distribution of material well-being.
👉 የውሳኔዎች ሚና: ግለሰቦች፣ ቤተሰቦችና ሀገራት ውስን ሀብታቸውን እንዴት እንደሚጠቀሙ የሚወስኑትን ምርጫ እና የውሳኔዎቹን ውጤት (Efficiency, Equity, Stability) ኢኮኖሚስቶች ያጠናሉ።


1.3 Scope and Method of Analysis in Economics

The field and scope of economics is expanding rapidly and has come to include a vast range of topics and issues (such as development economics, industrial economics, transport economics, welfare economics, environmental economics). However, the core of modern economics is formed by its two major branches: microeconomics and macroeconomics.
👉 የኢኮኖሚክስ ወሰን: ኢኮኖሚክስ በርካታ ዘርፎች ቢኖሩትም፣ የዘመናዊ ኢኮኖሚክስ ዋና ዋና ምሰሶዎች Microeconomics እና Macroeconomics ናቸው።

1.3.1 Scope of Economics

A. Microeconomics is concerned with the economic behavior of individual decision making units such as households, firms, markets and industries. In other words, it deals with how households and firms make decisions and how they interact in specific markets.
👉 Microeconomics (ማይክሮ-ኢኮኖሚክስ): በግል ደረጃ ያሉትን የኢኮኖሚ ክፍሎች (ስለ አንድ ግለሰብ፣ አንድ ቤተሰብ፣ ወይም አንድ ድርጅት ውሳኔ) ያጠናል።

B. Macroeconomics is a branch of economics that deals with the effects and consequences of the aggregate behaviour of all decision making units in a certain economy. In other words, it is an aggregative economics that examines the interrelations among various aggregates, their determination and the causes of fluctuations in them. It looks at the economy as a whole and discusses about the economy-wide phenomena.
👉 Macroeconomics (ማክሮ-ኢኮኖሚክስ): የአንድን ሀገር አጠቃላይ ኢኮኖሚ (Aggregates) በአንድ ላይ ያጠናል።

Microeconomics Summary
• Studies individual economic units of an economy. (ነጠላ የኢኮኖሚ ክፍሎችን ያጠናል)
• Deals with individual income, individual prices, individual outputs, etc. (ስለ ግል ገቢ፣ የግል ዋጋ እና ምርት ያጠናል)
• Its central problem is price determination and allocation of resources. (ዋና ችግሩ የዋጋ አወሳሰንና የሀብት ክፍፍል ነው)
• Its main tools are demand and supply of particular commodities. (ዋና መሳሪያዎቹ የአንድ ቃ እቃዎች Demand እና Supply ናቸው)
• Examples: Individual income, individual savings, individual prices, an individual firm's output.
Macroeconomics Summary
• Studies an economy as a whole and its aggregates. (ሀገራዊ አጠቃላይ ኢኮኖሚን ያጠናል)
• Deals with national income and output and general price level. (ስለ ሀገራዊ ገቢ፣ ምርት እና አጠቃላይ የዋጋ ደረጃ ያጠናል)
• Its central problem is determination of level of income and employment. (ዋና ችግሩ የሀገራዊ ገቢና የስራ እድል አወሳሰን ነው)
• Its main tools are aggregate demand and aggregate supply. (ዋና መሳሪያዎቹ Aggregate Demand እና Aggregate Supply ናቸው)
• Examples: National income, national savings, general price level, national output, aggregate consumption.

Note: Both microeconomics and macroeconomics are complementary to each other. That is, macroeconomics cannot be studied in isolation from microeconomics.
👉 ተሟላጭነት (Complementary): ማይክሮ እና ማክሮ ተነጣጥለው አይታዩም፤ አንዱ ለሌላው ማሟያ ነው።

💡 Exam Hint: በፈተና ላይ Micro vs Macro ልዩነት በጣም ይወጣል። ለምሳሌ፦ "Individual Income" ከተባለ Micro ሲሆን፣ "National Income" ወይም "Inflation" ከተባለ Macro መሆኑን ፈጥናችሁ ለዩ! (ሰንጠረዡ በስልክ ስክሪን እንዲመች በጥንቃቄ ተዘጋጅቷል)።


1.3.2 Positive and Normative Analysis

Is economics a positive science or normative science, or both? What is your justification?

Economics can be analyzed from two perspectives: positive economics and normative economics.

Positive economics: It is concerned with analysis of facts and attempts to describe the world as it is. It tries to answer the questions what was; what is; or what will be? It does not judge a system as good or bad, better or worse.
👉 Positive Economics (ሐቅ ተኮር): ነባራዊ ሁኔታውንና እውነታውን ብቻ ይገልጻል (What is / What will be)። እውነት ወይም ሐሰት መሆኑን መረጃ (Data/Facts) በመመልከት ማረጋገጥ ይቻላል። ምንም አይነት የግል አስተያየት አይጨምርም።

Example:
• The current inflation rate in Ethiopia is 12 percent.
• Poverty and unemployment are the biggest problems in Ethiopia.
• The life expectancy at birth in Ethiopia is rising.
All the above statements are known as positive statements. These statements are all concerned with real facts and information. Any disagreement on positive statements can be checked by looking in to facts.

Normative economics: It deals with the questions like, what ought to be? Or what the economy should be? It evaluates the desirability of alternative outcomes based on one's value judgments about what is good or what is bad. In this situation since normative economics is loaded with judgments, what is good for one may not be the case for the other. Normative analysis is a matter of opinion (subjective in nature) which cannot be proved or rejected with reference to facts.
👉 Normative Economics (አስተያየት ተኮር): "ምን መሆን አለበት?" (What ought to be / Should be) ለሚለው ጥያቄ የግል እሴትንና አስተያየት (Value judgment/Opinion) በመጨመር የሚሰጥ ሀሳብ ነው። በዳታ ማረጋገጥ አይቻልም፤ የሚወሰነው በድምፅ (Voting) ነው።

Example:
• The poor should pay no taxes.
• There is a need for intervention of government in the economy.
• Females ought to be given job opportunities.
Any disagreement on a normative statement can be solved by voting.

💡 Exam Hint: በፈተና ላይ "should"፣ "ought to" የሚሉ ቃላት ካሉ Normative Statement ነው። ፍፁም መረጃ እና እውነታ ያዘሉ አረፍተ ነገሮች ደግሞ Positive Statement ናቸው።


1.3.3 Inductive and Deductive Reasoning in Economics

The fundamental objective of economics, like any science, is the establishment of valid generalizations about certain aspects of human behaviour. Those generalizations are known as theories. A theory is a simplified picture of reality. Economic theory provides the basis for economic analysis which uses logical reasoning. There are two methods of logical reasoning: inductive and deductive.
👉 የምክንያታዊነት አስፈላጊነት: የኢኮኖሚክስ ዋና አላማ ስለ ሰው ልጅ ባህሪ አጠቃላይ ህጎችን (Theories) ማውጣት ሲሆን፣ ለዚህም ሁለት የReasoning ዘዴዎችን ይጠቀማል።

a) Inductive reasoning is a logical method of reaching at a correct general statement or theory based on several independent and specific correct statements. In short, it is the process of deriving a principle or theory by moving from facts to theories and from particular to general economic analysis.
👉 Inductive Reasoning (ከነጠላ ወደ አጠቃላይ): ከተወሰኑ የተበታተኑ እውነታዎችና መረጃዎች ተነስተን ወደ አጠቃላይ ቲዎሪ ወይም ደምዳሜ መድረስ ነው (Particular to General / Facts → Theory)።

Inductive method involves the following steps:
1. Selecting problem for analysis (ችግሩን መለየት)
2. Collection, classification, and analysis of data (መረጃ መሰብሰብና መተንተን)
3. Establishing cause and effect relationship between economic phenomena. (ምክንያትና ውጤትን ማገናኘት)

b) Deductive reasoning is a logical way of arriving at a particular or specific correct statement starting from a correct general statement. In short, it deals with conclusions about economic phenomenon from certain fundamental assumptions or truths or axioms through a process of logical arguments. The theory may agree or disagree with the real world and we should check the validity of the theory to facts by moving from general to particular.
👉 Deductive Reasoning (ከአጠቃላይ ወደ ነጠላ): ከአጠቃላይ ህግ ወይም ቲዎሪ ተነስተን የተወሰነውን ነገር ወይም ነጠላ እውነታ ማረጋገጥ ነው (General to Particular / Theory → Facts)።

Major steps in the deductive approach include:
1. Problem identification (ችግሩን መለየት)
2. Specification of the assumptions (መነሻ ግምቶችን መወሰን)
3. Formulating hypotheses (የመላ ምት ሀሳብ ማዘጋጀት)
4. Testing the validity of the hypotheses (የመላ ምቱን ትክክለኛነት ማረጋገጥ)

💡 Exam Hint: ፈተና ላይ የመጣጣስ እድላቸው ከፍተኛ ስለሆነ ያዙአቸው፦ Inductive = Particular to General (Facts → Theory)፣ Deductive = General to Particular (Theory → Facts)!
